risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, including cybersecurity incidents or other disruptions to information systems, which could have a significant impact on its operations and reputation

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Changes in regulations and laws, notably regarding global taxation and AI, could impact the company's operations and revenue
